def evolved_fsdp_prefetch(shards, M, N_LAYERS, rank, world_size,
                          num_devices, cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """single all-gather across all microbatches and layers."""
    flat = [shards[m][L] for m in range(M) for L in range(N_LAYERS)]
    stacked = torch.stack(flat, dim=0)        # [M*N_LAYERS, ..., shard_w]
    g = xm.all_gather(stacked, dim=-1)         # gather last dim in one shot
    outs = []
    i = 0
    for m in range(M):
        per_layer = []
        for L in range(N_LAYERS):
            per_layer.append(g[i])
            i += 1
        outs.append(per_layer)
    return outs
